# Integritrade LLC

> Integritrade LLC provides certified IT Asset Disposition (ITAD), electronics recycling, data destruction, and asset recovery solutions.

## About

Integritrade LLC specializes in secure technology lifecycle management, helping organizations safely retire, recycle, recover, and dispose of IT equipment.

## Services

- IT Asset Disposition (ITAD)
- Data Destruction Services
- Electronics Recycling
- Data Center Decommissioning
- Asset Recovery
- Remote IT Asset Recovery
- Certified Recycling Solutions

## Industries

- Business & Corporate
- Defense Contractors
- Education
- Finance
- Government & Public Sector
- Healthcare
- Legal & Professional Services
- Retail & Hospitality

## Certifications

Integritrade provides certified and compliant IT recycling and data destruction services.

## Location

Serving organizations across California and the United States.
